## Classification checklist (mandatory)

**Evidence class**

- [ ] `evidence:draft` — work in progress, may be amended
- [ ] `evidence:final` — becomes immutable; hash added to `audits/evidence-registry.csv` in this PR
- [ ] Not evidence (policy draft, tooling, docs)

**Retention classification**

- [ ] Short-term working artifact (< 1 year)
- [ ] Governance record (per `docs/retention-schedule.md`, class: ______ )
- [ ] Legal hold applies (reference: ______ )
- [ ] Contains **no** personal data — verified (PII scan passed)

**Lawful basis / GDPR impact**

- [ ] No impact on lawful basis, RoPA, or consent texts
- [ ] Impact exists → linked RoPA/DPIA/consent PRs: ______

**Sign-off**

- [ ] DPO notified/reviewed (required for policies/, dpia/, ropa/, incidents/)
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md updated (policy changes are mandatory entries)
